## Overview

Public Buffer marketing site, captured signed out on 2026-11-22. Values come from computed styles on the homepage. catalog.json was left alone, so this file was not produced by `make design-md`.

## Colors

Page `#fefdfb`, text `#213130`, accent `#b0ec9c`, muted `#6e6e68`, footer `#213130`.

## Typography

The hero uses Stolzl at 75.8px. Body and buttons use Figtree at 18px. Both families are proprietary and are not in the package.

## Layout

The header is about 73px. Primary actions are pills. The footer is the same near-black as the text.

## Elevation

The homepage email wrapper uses `0 4px 12px -2px rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.1), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.05)`.

## Shapes

Buttons and the email field use a 1440px radius.

## Components

Get started for free is the green pill. Log in is a text control. The outline colour on Log in was not measured.

## Do's and Don'ts

Paint the page warm white. Keep the primary action green. Do not invent a dark theme. Do not treat the signup illustration as the signed-in app.
